subject.title: fix(scripts): bound docs glossary git lookups

question: Should `OPENCLAW_DOCS_I18N_GLOSSARY_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` become a supported developer/CI environment contract, or should the timeout remain a fixed internal policy with a test-only seam?
rationale: The branch explicitly presents the environment variable as an option for slower local environments, while repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration and environment surfaces; this is a product and operator-contract choice rather than a purely mechanical correction.

options.title: Keep a fixed internal timeout
options.body: Remove the production environment override and use a test-only injectable timeout or executor so the checker has one documented runtime policy.

options.title: Adopt the override as supported
options.body: Document the variable, its one-minute default and ten-minute cap, and add coverage for invalid and capped values as a deliberate CI/operator contract.

recommendation.title: Keep a fixed internal timeout
recommendation.body: Remove the production environment override and use a test-only injectable timeout or executor so the checker has one documented runtime policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository guidance connects this person to the docs i18n pipeline whose slow-operation behavior this PR changes.
